resources.string: Tap a note to look inside
This is how the feed reads. Every name is an alias — join to feel, respond and write your own.

string-array.name: demo_texts
string-array.item: Sometimes I pretend I didn\'t see the message just to feel in control.
I told everyone I was proud of them, but I cried on the way home.
I still look for your car at every red light.
I moved to a new city for a fresh start and I\'ve eaten dinner alone every night for a month. Nobody here knows my name yet.
Got the job. Called my mum first. She cried more than I did.
Is it normal to miss someone you were the one to leave?
I laugh the loudest in every group chat so nobody asks how I\'m actually doing.
You never got to see me graduate. I wore your watch the whole day.
Today I said no to something I didn\'t want to do, and the world didn\'t end.
I keep a list of every kind thing a stranger has done for me. It\'s 41 lines long now.
